Controls for nested browser packing, marker evaluation, and concealed auto-submit click handoffs.

The renamed click handoff and alternate percent marker must retain two suspicious composites. Ordinary cookie use, visible encoded forms, plain SSO submission, hidden ActiveX controls, percent-marker decoding without evaluation, and commented-out scripts must activate none of the added suspicious composites.

The full original samples are external positive controls. Numeric packing is detected without requiring a filename, hostname, exact byte count, or token dictionary permutation. Its combination with a hidden ActiveX control remains suspicious: automatic unpacking is unavailable, so the rule cannot establish a particular exploit method or payload.
